proofUses.reason: A sparse independent layer yields exponential integrability at a larger parameter; the finite-cluster majorant and Cauchy estimates give the quantitative extension.
The uniform-susceptibility tree-graph moment bound (Y84V) is summed into the exponential series, followed by integration and Markov's inequality.
An exit path forces |K_o| > r/R, and the uniform-susceptibility volume bound (XLWI) gives the spatial decay.
The finite-cluster expansion is bounded termwise by complex-exponential estimates and summed under the assumed exponential moment via monotone coupling; no other wiki assertion is invoked.
